notes.title: Little optimizations and bug fixes
notes.content:
It's been 4 days since the pre-pre-pre-alpha playtesting started and from the feedback received I managed to take care of the most nefarious problems.

I made some tiny improvements to performance so hopefully some of you will experience a little boost in FPS. This is still not as great as it can be and will be an ongoing task. If you have a noticeable FPS boost, be sure to let me know! You can report in the feedback menu or you can swing by the newly made public discord channel:

https://discord.com/channels/802418749621534730/1233991560237023313

Thanks to everyone providing feedback and reports! New content updates are planned for early to mid-May!
